'''Premiere - Virtual Set 25 Draft''' is a draft format on [[GEMP]] using cards from [[Premiere]] through Virtual Set 25. The Players Committee Cube page calls it "GEMP - Holocron Prem-V25 Draft". Each player starts with dozens of the game's best locations, and some draftable cards bring add-on cards with them.<ref name="pc-cube" /> GEMP's draft list points this type to <code>/draft/holocron_premv25_draft.json</code>.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="drafts" />

* '''Type:''' booster draft (GEMP cube draft)
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee Cube page; GEMP draft file
* '''Card pool:''' Premiere through Virtual Set 25 cards; a large fixed set of locations, 54 picks per side, add-on cards
* '''In use:''' unknown
* '''GEMP:''' ''Premiere - Virtual Set 25 Draft'' (<code>holocron_premv25_draft</code>) on play.swccg.com; on the Players Committee GEMP the same draft file is played under the [[Cube]] format<ref name="pc-v25" />

== Card pool ==
For each side a player gets a fixed set that includes dozens of locations plus 10 other cards, and drafts 54 cards from a list of 300. Some draftable cards come with an add-on bonus, such as a pilot with a matching starship, and a few draftable objectives are mixed in.<ref name="pc-cube" /> The GEMP file has 201 fixed cards in all (99 Light Side, 102 Dark Side). In the pick lists, 27 Light Side and 29 Dark Side cards have add-ons, 28 and 30 add-on cards in all.<ref name="v25" />
* '''Dark Side fixed cards (besides 92 locations):''' ''Fear Is My Ally'', ''Prepared Defenses'', ''Ghhhk'', ''Sense'', ''Alter'', ''Secret Plans'', ''Begin Landing Your Troops'', ''Combat Response'' (V), ''Blaster Rack'' (V), ''Jawa''.<ref name="pc-cube" />
* '''Light Side fixed cards (besides 89 locations):''' ''An Unusual Amount Of Fear'', ''Heading For The Medical Frigate'', ''Houjix'', ''Sense'', ''Alter'', ''Aim High'', ''Security Control'', ''Squadron Assignments'', ''Sai'torr Kal Fas'' (V), ''Jawa''.<ref name="pc-cube" />
Players use their fixed, drafted and add-on cards to build their decks.<ref name="pc-cube" />

=== How picks work ===
GEMP shuffles each side's pick list and offers a shrinking "pack": 9 cards, then 8, down to 1, then 9 again, six times over 54 picks. A card already in the player's pool is not offered again, and a picked card brings any add-on cards listed for it.<ref name="dcb" /><ref name="v25" />

=== Deck rules ===
On play.swccg.com the format sets a deck size of 40 cards and is not a game hall format.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" /> The Players Committee code's draft file names its <code>cube</code> format instead, which sets 45 cards.<ref name="pc-v25" /><ref name="pc-gemp" /> The format's set list is the same as [[Open]]; the drafted pool limits what a player can use.<ref name="gemp" />

== History ==
The draft is one of the cubes on the Players Committee Cube page, which links older cubes, versions 1 to 7, from 2014 to 2020.<ref name="pc-cube" /> The Players Committee GEMP code has the same draft file under its Cube format; play.swccg.com gave it its own format.<ref name="pc-v25" /><ref name="v25" /><ref name="gemp" /> No source gives who built this cube or when, or what "Holocron" in its Players Committee name refers to, and no event result is recorded.
